notebooks.name: Water box from a data file (SPC/E)
notebooks.summary: read_data of 216 SPC/E water molecules (atoms, bonds, angles, charges, velocities), SHAKE, PPPM, the O-O RDF and the MSD.

notebooks.name: CO2 from a molecule template (TraPPE, rigid)
notebooks.summary: molecule command + create_atoms random: 200 rigid TraPPE CO2 molecules placed without overlaps, fix rigid/small with a Langevin thermostat.

notebooks.name: Liquid n-butane from a molecule template (TraPPE-UA)
notebooks.summary: create_atoms box mol on a lattice with random orientations, a flexible united-atom model (bonds, angles, OPLS dihedral), minimize, NVT, and the dihedral angle distribution.

notebooks.name: alpha-quartz from a CIF file (BKS)
notebooks.summary: A CIF crystal structure (P3221, symmetry expanded) converted to a triclinic data file with the import dialog, replicated, charges set, and run with the BKS potential under NPT.

notebooks.name: Ice Ih from a CIF file (rigid SPC/E water)
notebooks.summary: A molecular crystal from a CIF: bonds inferred through the periodic cell, molecules kept whole by image flags, rigid SPC/E water with fix rigid/nvt/small at 200 K.

notebooks.name: Urea crystal from a CIF file (structure check)
notebooks.summary: Symmetry expansion of a molecular CIF (P-421m) whose molecules cross the cell faces: the import keeps all 7 bonds of every molecule; replicate and count molecules and bond lengths.
